messages:
alex_kim: Hey team — need to get a short written + 60s video testimonial from CobaltWorks for next week's benchmark post. They can record Wed or Thu. Need AE to confirm talking points, PM to approve technical claims, legal to vet quote language. Also need copy and product to prepare social snippets. Timeline: draft by Tue EOD, legal by Wed noon, record Wed/Thu, publish next Mon. Who owns scheduling + quote signoff?

sam_ae: I can handle scheduling. Customer pref slots: Wed 10am PST or Thu 2pm PST. I'll DM them now and lock a time. Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/123456789

jordan_pm: I can sign off on the tech claims. Alex — can you post the exact metrics/phrasing we plan to use? e.g., "~30% latency drop" or "p99 reduction" — need to be precise.

milo_prod: @jordan_pm noted. If we mention latency or cost improvements we should include config baseline (batching off/on, model name obv masked). I'll draft the sidebar.

rita_legal: I'll review the quote language. If it's a straightforward customer praise, should be quick. Post the draft quote or share the drive link.

alex_kim: Drive with assets + draft quote: https://drive.google.com/file/d/abc123. Draft quote: "Redwood Inference helped us reduce latency by ~30% while lowering per-call cost." Please redline by Wed 12:00 PST if possible.

luna_ops: I can create a one-pager with recommended Zoom settings, mic tips, and a recording checklist. Happy to run through a tech check 10min before recording.

sam_ae: Customer confirmed Wed 10am PST. Calendar invite sent and I added a short Q list here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1fake. I'll ask for a 60s highlight clip + permission to edit.

jordan_pm: Draft phrasing for blog: "30% reduction in p99 latency on our real-time routing with continuous batching" — probably okay but let's avoid exact model/version. @rita_legal any flags?

rita_legal: Quick redlines: remove absolute words like "guaranteed", change "reduce" -> "helped reduce". Avoid naming internal configs. I'll add inline edits by 11:30am.

alex_kim: Great — copy team will draft the blog outline and social cuts after legal signoff. Need a 2-line exec quote from the customer (short, on-brand). Sam, can you collect?

milo_prod: I'll produce a 150-200 word technical sidebar for the blog and provide graphs (simple before/after latency chart). Where to drop assets?

alex_kim: Drop assets in the Drive folder above. Please label files like: cw-60s-final.mp4, cw-transcript-v1.docx, cw-graphs.png

publish-bot: scheduled -> channel:#marketing draft-review due:2026-03-10T18:00Z

sam_ae: Got it. I'll aim to get the exec quote and the 60s clip by Thu EOD. If we get legal signoff today we can accelerate.

alex_kim: Thanks everyone. Quick checklist: 1) legal redline by Wed noon 2) record Wed 10am 3) draft blog & assets by Fri EOD 4) publish next Mon. Ping here if blockers. :rocket:
